title: VPC failover dry-run orchestrator & preflight runbook for multi-region Private deployments
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create an orchestrator-style dry-run and preflight runbook for Private (VPC) multi-region failover drills. The goal is a reproducible, low-risk sequence that exercises Terraform-based cutover steps, state promotion, DNS steering, KV-lock fencing, and post-cutover health validators without impacting production traffic. This ticket will deliver: a Terraform-friendly orchestrator harness, a standard preflight checklist, automated non-destructive validations (smoke and latency checks), and a reporting artifact with pass/fail signals and diagnostic links.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Orchestrator can execute a full dry-run of the VPC cutover sequence using test tenants and tagged resources; no traffic or writable state from production is altered.
2) Preflight checks implemented: infra tags, KV-lock status, IAM policies, S3/DB read-only snapshot validations, DNS TTL sanity, and route table consistency.
3) Post-dry-run validators emit metrics into Console (route latency, error-rate, model-compatibility check) and report a clear pass/fail summary.
4) Runbook documents required Terraform modules, flagging any destructive operations and providing safe roll-forward/rollback commands.
5) Observability dashboards link and run artifacts (Terraform plan outputs, smoke test logs, cloud provider events) are attached to the drill report.
6) Playbook supports both scheduled smoke-only runs and full simulated failovers (with state promotion simulated) via a single orchestrator CLI flag.
7) Security review completed for executing the runbook in customer VPCs (KMS access paths and least-privilege IAM scoped).
tasks: Design orchestrator state machine and idempotent steps (preflight -> dry-run-plan -> simulate-cutover -> validators -> report)
Add terraform modules to perform non-destructive plan/apply for test namespaces and output safe plan artifacts
Implement KV-lock fencing simulator to validate leader election and lock expiry handling without modifying production locks
Create automated validators: synthetic traffic generator, healthcheck suite (liveness, model integrity), latency histogram collectors
Wire metrics and logs into Console: create per-drill dashboard template and attach run artifact store (S3/GCS)
Author runbook markdown and checklist for on-call / platform ops with explicit preconditions and rollback steps
Create a GitHub repo skeleton and initial PR with CI job that runs the dry-run harness on a sandbox account
Coordinate security review for KMS/IAM access and document minimal permissions required
